name: BAIC Motor Corporation Limited
summary: BAIC Motor Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells passenger vehicles in the People's Republic of China. The company provides luxury passenger cars, luxury commercial vehicles, middle-end and high-end passenger cars, and self-owned passenger cars, as well as electric passenger cars. It also provides auto engines, and powertrain and other parts and components. The company sells its products under the Beijing Brand, Beijing Benz, Beijing Hyundai, and Fujian Benz names. It is also involved in the car financing and automobile after-sales businesses, as well as investment management business. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
